must.item: Output contains the full 10-second office exchange
must.why: No video was produced; the agent stopped without running the swap.

faults.what: No deliverable: the agent refused to run the swap and kept asking the user for positions after the user said to do what it thinks best.

The agent claimed it couldn't view face crops, but it could have used the face detection images/mapping. The clip has three people, including a man on the left, a man in the middle and a woman on the right. Faces A and B are men, so it could not have mapped them reliably, but it should have raised that the clip has two men and one woman instead of repeating the same request.
The user's premise (two people) conflicts with the clip (two men and a woman); this was never surfaced clearly.

summary: No video was produced; the agent stalled and asked for left/right positions even though the user had delegated the decision, and the clip shows two men and one woman, which it never pointed out.
